posts: Weekly check (2026-11-16): news sites and the third-party tracking services they contact before you click anything. 37 of 48 sites measured, from GitHub servers in the US. Most: The Independent 93, Evening Standard 92, Daily Mirror 90. Thread below. Automated post. #privacy #adtech #GDPR

By country, the median number of tracking services contacted before any click, with the sites measured in brackets: DE 1 (10), ES 10 (11), UK 70 (8), US 46 (8). All measured from GitHub servers in the US: sites that show their consent banner only to European visitors look worse here.

Changes since last week (stable in most passes):
AS: dropped 1rx.io, 33across.com (+38 more)
New York Post: dropped 360yield.com, a-mo.net (+29 more)
ABC: added smilewanted.com
All 15 changes: https://joseasenjo.github.io/tracker-watch/changes.html

How: pages load with no clicks for 12s, 3 passes, median. Third party = other registered domain, matched to a limited list (may be incomplete). 11 sites blocked/unmeasured. Counts, not legal verdicts. Method and data: https://joseasenjo.github.io/tracker-watch/
alt_text: Bar chart of the number of third-party tracking services contacted before any interaction, measurement of 2026-11-16. The Independent: 93; Evening Standard: 92; Daily Mirror: 90; The Times: 74; The Sun: 66; The Guardian: 65.
